abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic cancer is a highly lethal malignancy. We therefore aimed to compare RNA concentration, purity, integrity, and laboratory-assigned pre-assay quality control (QC) classifications between paired fresh-frozen (FF) and formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded (FFPE) endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine-needle biopsy (EUS-FNB) specimens from solid pancreatic lesions.
METHODS: We evaluated 36 pairs of FF and FFPE EUS-FNB specimens for RNA concentration, absorbance ratios, RNA quality numbers (RQNs), and pre-assay QC classifications. FF tissues were placed in RNAlater-containing tubes, snap-frozen and transported in liquid nitrogen before storage in an ultra-low-temperature freezer at -80 °C at the biobank, whereas FFPE specimens were processed and stored according to routine institutional protocols. QC classifications were assigned by the analytical laboratory based on RNA measurements, electropherograms, and estimated assay input requirements.
RESULTS: FF specimens had significantly higher RNA concentrations, A260/A280 and A260/A230 ratios, and RQNs than paired FFPE specimens (all p < 0.001). No specimens achieved "Pass" status. All 36 FF specimens were classified as "Hold," whereas 25 of 36 FFPE specimens (69.4%) were classified as "Fail" (p < 0.001). Archival storage duration was significantly longer in the FFPE "Fail" group than in the "Hold" group (median, 5.52 versus 4.14 months; p = 0.006).
CONCLUSIONS: The FF workflow yielded significantly superior RNA quality metrics and fewer pre-assay QC failures than the FFPE workflow. Placement of specimens in tubes prefilled with RNAlater, followed by snap-freezing and storage at -80 °C, may offer a practical strategy for banking small pancreatic EUS-FNB specimens. However, as pre-assay QC does not guarantee downstream assay success, further validation of profiling performance and long-term stability is warranted.
key_points_ko: FF 검체는 paired FFPE 검체에 비해 RNA 농도, A260/A280, A260/A230 비율, RQN에서 통계적으로 유의하게 우수한 결과를 보였습니다 (모두 p < 0.001).
36개의 FF 검체 중 완벽한 통과(Pass) 판정을 받은 것은 없으며 모두 보류(Hold)로 분류되었습니다.
36개의 FFPE 검체 중 25개(69.4%)는 품질 관리 검사에서 실패(Fail)로 분류되었습니다 (p < 0.001).
FFPE 실패 그룹의 보관 기간은 중앙값 5.52개월로, 보류 그룹의 4.14개월보다 유의하게 길었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 고형 췌장 병변에서 채취한 짝을 이룬 신선동결(FF)과 포르말린 고정 파라핀 포매(FFPE) 췌장 내시경 초음파 유도 세침조직검사(EUS-FNB) 검체 간의 RNA 농도, 순도, 무결성 및 품질 관리(QC) 분류를 비교했습니다. 총 36쌍의 검체를 평가한 결과, FF 검체는 FFPE 검체에 비해 RNA 농도, 흡광도 비율, RNA 품질 번호(RQN)가 통계적으로 유의하게 더 높았습니다. FF 검체는 모두 보류(Hold) 판정을 받았고, FFPE 검체 중 69.4%는 실패(Fail) 판정을 받았습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않은 임상 결과는 없습니다.
title: Comparative Analysis of RNA Quality Between Paired Fresh-Frozen and Formalin-Fixed, Paraffin-Embedded Pancreatic Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Fine-Needle Biopsy Specimens: Implications for Biobanking and Molecular Diagnostics
title_ko: 신선동결 및 포르말린 고정 파라핀 포매 췌장 내시경 초음파 유도 세침조직검사 검체의 RNA 품질 비교 분석: 바이오뱅킹 및 분자 진단을 위한 시사점
